rows.text: calls `0024AD00(rcx, rdx, r8, r9d)`; then, for `r9d` entries of 0x10 bytes from `rcx` (none when `r9d` is not greater than 0, signed), sets dword `+0` to (dword `+0` - 0x8000) shifted right 4 (arithmetic) plus the truncated 0x200 (`01E0C1D8`, as a float) / `00183280()` shifted right 1, and dword `+4` to (dword `+4` - 0x8000) shifted right 4 plus dword `01E0C1DC` (0x1C0) shifted right 1

returns 0 when bit `0x1` of byte `02098E20` is clear, when qword `02098E10` is null or when `0020E600(dword +0x8c of it)` is null; otherwise, with `b` = that qword plus the sign-extended low dword of a second `0020E600(dword +0x8c)`, returns `b` + 4 + `ecx`*0x10 when `ecx` is less than dword `[b]` (signed), else 0
when `ecx` is less than 0x100 (signed), bit `0x1` of byte `02098E20` is set and qword `02098E58` is non-null, stores `dx` as word `ecx` of the array that qword points to; otherwise it stores nothing
returns 0x1D when `ecx` is above 9 (unsigned); otherwise a jump table maps 0 to 0, 1 to 1, 2 to 9, 3 to 7 to 0x12 to 0x16, 8 to 0x1D and 9 to 0x1E
leaves word `+0x2f0` unchanged when no bit other than `0x4` is set in it (`test` with `0xfffb`); otherwise stores 4 there when it equals 1 and 3 when it does not
with `t` = qword `02CA6C60`, returns dword `ecx` of the array at `t+8` AND 0x1FFF when `ecx` is less than dword `t+4` (signed), else -1
multiplies each of the four floats at `rdx` `+0`/`+4`/`+8`/`+0xc` by 16.0 (`01CEBC84`) and stores each truncated to an integer as the dword at the same offset of `rcx`

notes: drafted by OPUS itself; 002E13C0's case values read from the jump table bytes (not named)
